title: Payload fingerprint guardian for regression hunting on config/model changes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a lightweight, model-and-config-aware payload fingerprinting service to detect quality regressions in structured JSON outputs when model binaries or serving config change. The fingerprint will encode field presence, type signatures, common categorical value sets, and summarized token-level anomalies so we can attribute changes to specific model/config deltas rather than noisy downstream variance. The service should integrate with our eval pipeline and alerting (PagerDuty/console) and produce compact telemetry suitable for high-cardinality grouping and rollouts.
goals: Create a deterministic payload fingerprint format (stable across equivalent permutations) that captures shape + coarse value statistics
Expose a fingerprinting library in the eval runner and runtime post-processing hook
Correlate fingerprint deltas with model/config change events and surface ranked regression candidates
Provide signal to canary/rollout system to automatically flag suspicious model/config changes for review or automatic rollback
acceptance_criteria: Fingerprint produced for 99% of sampled inference responses across production traffic without adding >5ms p50 latency in post-processing pipeline
Fingerprint deltas correctly detect injected synthetic regressions in 90%+ of tests in the lab harness
Integration with alerting: on configurable threshold, a regression alert is created in the Console with affected model, config, and top differing fields
Dashboard shows per-model/config fingerprint histograms and time-series; drilldown links to sample payloads and diffs
implementation_notes: Fingerprinting algorithm: canonicalize keys (sorted), record presence bitmap, primitive type tokens (string/number/bool/null/array/object) and per-field summary stats (approx distinct counts via HyperLogLog, short value histograms using quantiles)
Avoid storing raw payloads in high-cardinality buckets; keep compact summaries and pointers to sampled raw examples for human review
Include the model_metadata and serving_config fingerprint alongside payload fingerprint so alerts can be grouped by exact config diff
Store fingerprints in the telemetry pipeline (ClickHouse or equivalent) partitioned by model_version, region, and route
tradeoffs_discussed: Strong fingerprint granularity improves root-cause but increases cardinality -> mitigate with rollup buckets and sampling
Canonicalization cost vs false positives: heavy canonicalization (e.g., sorting arrays) reduces noise but is more CPU-intensive; we'll apply heuristics per-route
Retaining examples for debugging increases storage cost; we will keep 30-day retention for flagged samples only
test_plan: Unit tests for canonicalizer and hash stability across equivalent JSON permutations
Synthetic regression suite: mutate field types/omissions/value distributions and assert fingerprint delta triggers
Performance tests built into traffic shadowing harness with 1M sample replay to validate latency/throughput budget
End-to-end demo: create canary model change, validate alert + rollback recommendation path
rollout_plan: Alpha: run in eval runner and offline telemetry for 2 weeks on nightly traffic (no alerts) to tune thresholds
Beta: enable alerting for internal teams on non-critical routes with one-week guardrails
GA: turn on alerting for critical routes, integrate with canary rollback automation and PagerDuty
monitoring_signals: Top-k field presence changes percentage across sampled traffic
Per-field type flip rate (e.g., string->object) above threshold
Correlation score between config diff and fingerprint delta (high means likely regression)
comments: 2025-02-14 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes posted to Confluence. Agreed fingerprint must be stable for permutations and inexpensive to compute. Miguel volunteered to prototype the canonicalizer.

2025-02-20 - Miguel Ortega: Initial canonicalizer prototype available in rw-evals branch. Early microbench shows ~2.8ms per payload for median small responses; need to shave to <=2ms. Exploring a native Rust module for hot path.
2025-02-26 - Design review (PR feedback): PM wants alerting noise controls and UI grouping by route+customer. Suggested adding an adaptive threshold that scales with baseline entropy.

2025-02-28 - Security review note: storing sampled payloads flagged for debugging requires PII scrubber; security asked for a proof of concept for field-level redaction before retention. Assigned to ENG-70211 for PII scrubber work.

2025-03-01 - Miguel Ortega: Ran synthetic regression suite. Detected >92% of injected type-flip regressions. Observed false positives on routes with heavy deterministic user-generated text; added heuristic to ignore fields matching long freeform text patterns.
